dog.description_text:
Hi! My name is Reacher AKA Rue and I just arrived to NYC!

I am calm and I am so sweet.
So far I'm not too playful but I am good with cats and dogs and people!

I have a unique dark brown/reddish coat that magically becomes a light golden brown in the sun.

I am down to lay down whenever for as long as possible. Pet me all you want, I’m not offended. I don’t really make any noise either!

I am currently very fearful and very scared of loud noises behind me and fast moving objects so the city is hard for me but with some confidence I could possibly get used to it. For now I have to avoid loud sudden noises as much as possible, they scare me and sometimes I circle and then lay down because of it or try to run, so I need a strong leader. My foster daddy is working hard to see if I can become a good fit for the city, or if I'm going to have to live outside the city since it feels so overwhelming right now.

I can’t wait to settle in and start enjoying treats and learning some commands.

The city is big and scary through my soulful angel eyes but I’m excited for this new adventure!
dog.name: Reacher
